summary: Competition check 2026-10-09 for AS06: 30 market actors recorded (6 competitors, 16 alternatives); details list what each does, its traction signal, licence and the gap versus the candidate. Source files: R4-ai-os.md under docs/inquiry/agentic-stack-2026-10-09/research/.
details:
- Dataiku (Agent Hub, LLM Mesh, Agent Management) [benchmark]: Enterprise AI platform: governed agent building with templates and IT-approved agent library; LLM gateway with provider switching; Agent Management inventories agents on external platforms (GA Oct 2026). Gap/note: The 'Dataiku-like out of the box' reference; enterprise-priced, no SME packaging. Traction: ~$342M ARR Sep 2025 (estimate); $3.7B valuation 2022 (https://sacra.com/c/dataiku/). Licence: Proprietary; quote-only. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Microsoft Agent 365 / Foundry model router / Copilot Studio [alternative]: Agent 365 governs Microsoft, partner and third-party agents; model router routes prompts across OpenAI/Anthropic/xAI/DeepSeek/Meta models within Azure Policy-governed subsets, honoring data zones. Gap/note: Copilot Business SMB bundle (~$21/user/mo, secondary). Traction: Agent 365 GA 2026-05-01 at $15/user/mo (https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/05/01/microsoft-agent-365-now-generally-available-expands-capabilities-and-integrations/). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Salesforce Agentforce [alternative]: CRM-centred agent platform. Gap/note: Only for Salesforce-centric organisations. Traction: >$1B Agentforce ARR, Q1 FY27 (company) (https://salesforce.com/news/press-releases/2026/05/27/fy27-q1-earnings). Licence: Proprietary; Flex Credits $500/100k (secondary). Checked 2026-10-09.
- Google Gemini Enterprise [alternative]: Workplace AI with prebuilt Google agents, no-code Agent Designer and agent Inbox (secondary). Gap/note: Business edition ~$21/seat (secondary). Traction: not found (https://workagent.ai/gemini-enterprise-pricing). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- ServiceNow AI Agents / AI Control Tower [alternative]: Workflow agents; Control Tower governs agents incl. third-party (secondary); Moveworks acquired 2025-12-15. Gap/note: Enterprise only. Traction: 5.5M employee users across ServiceNow+Moveworks (company) (https://newsroom.servicenow.com/press-releases/details/2025/ServiceNow-completes-acquisition-of-Moveworks/default.aspx). Licence: Proprietary; quote-only. Checked 2026-10-09.
- OpenAI Frontier [benchmark]: Enterprise platform to build and manage 'AI coworkers', incl. agents built elsewhere; onboarding and feedback loop; limited availability. Gap/note: Feedback-loop framing for agents; enterprise, not GA. Traction: Named customers HP, Oracle, State Farm, Uber (https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/05/openai-launches-a-way-for-enterprises-to-build-and-manage-ai-agents/). Licence: Proprietary; pricing undisclosed. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Writer [alternative]: Enterprise agentic AI platform with own models. Gap/note: Enterprise only. Traction: $1.9B valuation, $200M Series C, Nov 2024 (https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20241112482564/en/Writer-Raises-200M-Series-C-at-1.9B-Valuation-to-Fuel-Leadership-in-Agentic-Enterprise-AI). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Glean [alternative]: Enterprise search plus agent builder. Gap/note: Enterprise, search-first. Traction: >$300M ARR (company, 2026) (https://www.glean.com/press/glean-surpasses-300m-arr-unrivaled-enterprise-context-fuels-ai-adoption). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Kore.ai [alternative]: Enterprise agent platform (Artemis, May 2026); Agent 365 partner. Gap/note: Enterprise CX/EX. Traction: Strategic growth investment led by AllianceBernstein, Jan 2026 (undisclosed) (https://www.kore.ai/news/kore-ai-secures-strategic-growth-investment-from-alliancebernstein-to-scale-the-next-phase-of-agentic-enterprise-ai). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Sierra [benchmark]: Enterprise CX agents; Explorer produces weekly improvement recommendations that Ghostwriter can implement with before/after comparison (vendor claim). Gap/note: Productized corrections/insights-to-improvement loop, CX only. Traction: $15.8B valuation May 2026; ~$200M ARR (estimate) (https://sacra.com/c/sierra/). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Decagon [benchmark]: Enterprise CX agents. Gap/note: CX only. Traction: $4.5B valuation, $250M Series D, Jan 2026 (https://www.finsmes.com/2026/01/decagon-raises-250m-in-series-d-funding.html). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Ema [competitor]: 'Universal AI employee' agent platform for enterprises. Gap/note: Same AI-employee positioning, enterprise segment. Traction: $77M Series B, $140M total, Sep 2026 (https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/ema-raises-77m-series-b-130000096.html). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Langdock [competitor]: Berlin multi-model AI workspace: chat, agents, workflows, API over 40+ models; EU-hosted API; governance add-on with agent review/approval and EU AI Act/GDPR rule templates. Gap/note: Direct: EU, per-seat, governance; no documented correction-learning loop. Traction: ~$42M ARR Jun 2026 (estimate); ~$3.5M raised (https://sacra.com/c/langdock/). Licence: Proprietary; EUR 25/99 per user/mo. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Dust [competitor]: Paris multi-model team-agent platform with EU or US data residency; self-serve up to 100 people. Gap/note: Direct: EU residency, SME pricing; no correction-to-proposal loop found. Traction: $40M Series B 2026; $6M ARR 2025 (https://thenextweb.com/news/dust-series-b-40-million-multiplayer-ai-enterprise). Licence: MIT repository; EUR 24/seat/mo (yearly). Checked 2026-10-09.
- Lindy [competitor]: Assistant/agent platform with built-in approvals for outside-impact actions and editable memory. Gap/note: SMB AI employees; residency not stated; correction learning is vendor claim. Traction: ~$50M raised (estimate) (https://getlatka.com/companies/lindyai). Licence: Proprietary; $29.99-$199.99/user/mo. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Relevance AI [competitor]: No-code multi-agent 'Workforce'; pricing page now enterprise-only with evals and A/B testing. Gap/note: AI-workforce positioning; moved upmarket. Traction: $24M Series B, May 2025 (https://relevanceai.com/blog/the-ai-workforce-revolution-24m-series-b-to-accelerate-our-mission). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Zapier Agents [alternative]: Agents over Zapier's integration catalogue. Gap/note: Generic SME automation. Traction: not found (https://a8gent.com/platforms/zapier-agents). Licence: Proprietary; Pro ~$50/mo (secondary). Checked 2026-10-09.
- Make AI Agents [alternative]: Agents inside Make scenarios, 3,000+ integrations. Gap/note: Generic SME automation. Traction: not found (https://www.make.com/en/ai-agents). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- StackAI [alternative]: No-code enterprise agent builder. Gap/note: Enterprise builder. Traction: $16M Series A, May 2025 (https://www.stackai.com/blog/stack-ai-raises-16m-series-a-to-create-ai-agents-for-every-job). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Beam AI [benchmark]: 'Self-learning' process agents with human approval for critical tasks; EU or on-prem deployment (vendor claims). Gap/note: Learning claim without documented reviewable proposals. Traction: Unclear; $1.35M round Aug 2025 per PitchBook (https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/512244-91). Licence: Proprietary; quote-only. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Artisan [benchmark]: AI SDR 'employee' (Ava). Gap/note: AI-employee framing, single function. Traction: $25M Series A, Apr 2025 (https://www.artisan.co/blog/artisan-series-a). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- 11x [benchmark]: AI SDR 'digital workers'. Gap/note: Cautionary: reported customer-claim and churn issues (secondary). Traction: Benchmark/a16z-backed; reported credibility issues (secondary) (https://thecroreport.com/tools/11x/). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Anthropic Claude Cowork / Managed Agents / Claude Code cloud sessions [alternative]: Cowork GA with RBAC, spend limits, OTel; Managed Agents hosted sandboxed runtime (public beta); Claude Code cloud sessions in isolated VMs. Gap/note: Team/Enterprise seats bundle agents for employees. Traction: Cowork GA 2026-04-09 (https://thenewstack.io/anthropic-takes-claude-cowork-out-of-preview-and-straight-into-the-enterprise/). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Mistral AI (Vibe, AI Studio) [competitor]: Vibe (ex-Le Chat) Work Mode proposes plans and waits for approval; AI Studio offers runtime, observability, registry with promotion gates, self-hosted option; EU hosting by default. Gap/note: EU workspace at ~$24.99/user/mo Team; Mistral-model centric. Traction: EUR 3B Series D Sep 2026 at >EUR 21B (secondary) (https://valueaddvc.com/blog/mistral-ai-valuation-revenue-2026-europe-ai-champion). Licence: Proprietary platform; some open-weight models. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Dify [alternative]: Open-source visual agentic workflow and RAG platform with Cloud, self-hosted and Enterprise editions. Gap/note: Self-hostable builder for SMEs with IT staff. Traction: 158k GitHub stars; $30M pre-A at $180M valuation, Mar 2026 (https://github.com/langgenius/dify). Licence: Dify Open Source License (Apache-2.0 + multi-tenant and logo conditions). Checked 2026-10-09.
- n8n [alternative]: Fair-code workflow automation with AI agents, provider switching and human approvals. Gap/note: SME automation incumbent; SAP-embedded. Traction: 206.8k stars; $5.2B valuation; 1,400+ enterprise customers (2026-05-12) (https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/n8n-valuation-doubles-to-5-2bn-as-sap-makes-strategic-investment-and-plans-to-embed-the-ai-platform-into-joule-studio-302767222.html). Licence: Sustainable Use License + n8n Enterprise License (.ee). Checked 2026-10-09.
- Paperclip [alternative]: Open-source orchestration for teams of AI agents: org charts, Ready-Made Teams, budgets with auto-pause, approval stages, plugins, adapters for Claude Code/Codex/Cursor/Gemini CLI; Paperclip Cloud waitlist. Gap/note: For technical SMEs only. Traction: ~99.1k GitHub stars (https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Replit [alternative]: Prompt-to-app agent platform. Gap/note: Adjacent: SMEs building internal apps. T
